title: Two 'no identity sources available' branches are now unreachable
description:
registry.rs:106-107 warns 'no identity sources available; hired will issue no SVIDs' when active.is_empty(), and hire/src/main.rs:197-199 prints 'no identity sources active'. The #[cfg(unix)] push at registry.rs:99-104 makes both dead on Linux, macOS and BSD.

hire-attestors does not cross-compile to Windows today (ungated tokio::net::UnixStream in ssh.rs and tailscale.rs), so neither branch is reachable by anything that currently builds. Correct for a future non-unix target; dead today.
notes: HALF FIXED 2026-09-15. hire/src/main.rs's dead branch is gone -- enumerate_summary() always reports a count and the old collapsed wording was removed. STILL DEAD: hire-attestors/src/registry.rs's 'if active.is_empty() { tracing::warn!(...) }' branch is unreachable on every currently-buildable target, because the cfg(unix) block immediately above it always pushes UnixAttestor. It becomes reachable only if a non-unix target ever builds.
